question: Which Department of the Government of India launched 'One Health' pilot project in April 2022?

options.text: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying

solution:
The correct answer is __**Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The One Health project has been launched by the **Department of Animal Husbandary & Dairying**(DAHD) and Confederation of Indian Industries(CII) along with the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation(BMGF).
 
• One Health has been launched as a pilot project in Uttarakhand.
 
• The following activities are intended to be performed under the One Health pilot project:

 
• Data Collection on Disease outbreaks
 
• Management and development of surveillance plans
 
• Integration of network of Laboratories
 
• Development and implementation of communication strategies across various sectors
 
• Data Integration of National Digital Livestock Mission's digital architecture

 
• According to DAHD the “One Health India” program initiated by the Department will work with stakeholders from various sectors to improve the following through technology and finance:

 
• Livestock health
 
• Human health
 
• Wildlife health
 
• Environmental health.
